title: Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.32474v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. translated_title: 超越事后奖励：面向多模态嵌入的特权推理探索
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的进展推动了多模态嵌入领域的显著发展。近期方法利用模型的生成能力，通过自生成的推理来增强被嵌入的输入，从而产生信息更丰富的嵌入表示。然而，用于训练嵌入模型的传统检索监督仅指定成对相关性关系，并未显式引导用于输入增强的推理过程。这类推理既无法被直接观测，也不由输入唯一确定，因此多种合理的推理轨迹可能引入检索效用各异的语义线索。现有方法大多仅在输入条件下优化推理，限制了对与检索相关轨迹的探索。我们提出PILOT框架，将推理建模为潜在变量，并将该变量的先验分布与后验分布实例化为同一共享MLLM的两种不同推理模式。其中，先验仅……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PILOT框架，将自生成推理建模为潜在变量，通过共享多模态大语言模型的先验与后验两种推理模式进行特权推理探索，从而发现更具检索效用的推理轨迹，突破传统仅以输入为条件的事后奖励优化的局限，提升多模态嵌入的质量。
en_tdlr: PILOT models self-generated reasoning as a latent variable, instantiating its prior and posterior as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM, enabling privileged exploration of retrieval-relevant reasoning traces and improving multimodal embeddings beyond post-hoc, input-only reward optimization.
